title: The ice composition in the disk around V883 Ori revealed by its stellar outburst
question: Can the outburst-driven expansion of the snow line in V883 Ori reveal the ice composition (COM abundances) of the disk midplane, and how does it compare with hot corinos and comets?

data.sensitivity: RMS 4 mJy/beam (Cycle 4 lines, tapered); 7-8 mJy/beam (Cycle 5 lines)

what.value: Stellar mass 1.2 Msun, midplane snow line, source velocity 4.3 km/s, T_mid(0.1")=100 K

evidence.quote: The source velocity is 4.3 km s$^{-1}$(cite: Cieza2016).

what.value: Dust absorption opacity at 1.3 mm of 2.2 cm2/g and Tatm/Tmid=2

evidence.quote: dust absorption opacity at 1.3 mm ($2.2~{\rm cm^2 g^{-1}}$)(cite: Cieza2018)
multiplied by the elemental abundance of $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C$=60$(cite: Langer1993)

what.value: COM abundances in IRAS 16293B and comets for comparison

evidence.quote: higher than those in the hot corino IRAS 16293 B(cite: Jorgensen2016; Lykke2017; Calcutt2018b)

recipe.method: Standard CASA reduction; Briggs imaging, tapered for Cycle 4 lines
key_parameters: Cycle 4 uv-taper 1000 klambda, robust 0.5; Cycle 5 robust 0.0

recipe.method: Median distance of 47 Gaia DR2 L1641 members near V883 Ori
assumptions: V883 Ori Gaia parallax unreliable, so cluster distance adopted

recipe.goal: Fit COM column densities in spectra
recipe.method: Extract spectra in 0.6" circular aperture, shift to source velocity, fit LTE model with XCLASS/MAGIX
key_parameters: FWHM fixed at 2 km/s, Tex = 120 K, emission size 0.6"

recipe.goal: Derive disk temperature and density structure (Models A and B)
recipe.method: Solve dust continuum radiative transfer on Band 6 high-res image for N_H2(r) and Tmid(r); Model B adds isothermal accretion-heated midplane inside snow line
key_parameters: Tmid(r>0.1")=100 K x sqrt(0.1"/r); gamma=1.5; H/r=0.1; kappa 2.2 cm2/g at 1.3 mm
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; Tatm/Tmid = 2; beta = 1; gas and dust temperatures equal

recipe.goal: Model 13CH3OH line emission and compare with high-res radial profile
recipe.method: LTE line radiative transfer with sublimation at 80 K, smoothed to 0.11" resolution; midplane contribution via zero-abundance in |z|<=H
